reason: 54 crowns a can is almost double what I pay for Big Shock or Monster when the 4-packs are on offer, and I'm not committing 649 plus shipping to twelve cans of something I've never tasted. I'd grab a free tasting can at an event, but I won't pay for a whole pack.
objection: It's way too expensive per can compared to what I already drink, and the numbered first-run thing doesn't mean anything to me, I just want a cheap kick.
would_change_my_mind: A single can or a 4-pack in a normal shop on offer for around 35 CZK a can, so I could try it without buying twelve.
